title: 霍金路伟科斯特雷瓦：中期选举后，企业该乐观还是警惕？
speaker: Ben Kostreva

segments.en: And does this, are we talking about 2028 now? What does it mean until now until then? Well, before we start talking about 2028, let's take a day just to be happy and optimistic that there were elections around the country. There wasn't any interference either at a federal level or a foreign
segments.zh: 现在要谈2028年了吗？从现在到那时意味着什么？在谈2028年前，先花一天为全国选举感到高兴和乐观。没有联邦或外国层面的干预。

segments.en: level. There wasn't any violence. The elections went forth and elected a lot of candidates that represented the districts and states all over the country, represent their culture, their economics,
segments.zh: 没有暴力。选举顺利进行，选出了许多代表全国各地选区和州的候选人，代表他们的文化、经济、

segments.en: their politics. And so we can look forward to 2028 elections starts probably today. But for a moment, we can just enjoy the fact that we have a slate of candidates who are becoming representatives around
segments.zh: 和政治。所以我们可以期待2028年选举可能今天就开始。但此刻，我们可以享受一个事实：一批候选人正在成为全国各地的代表，

segments.en: the country that I think are leading their districts in a very positive way. Of course, now they have to govern and that'll get more complicated, but it's good to start now. Ben, I don't want to dampen
segments.zh: 我认为他们正以非常积极的方式领导他们的选区。当然，现在他们必须治理，这会变得更复杂，但现在开始是好事。本，我不想扫兴。
